data.body:
CORRECTION (orchestrator, 2026-08-19 22:08 UTC) — the CI diagnosis recorded earlier on this ticket
is WRONG and should not be acted on.

CLAIMED: GitHub Actions runners in navapbc/rebar "have been starved for hours", with "every
unrelated workflow in the repo" queued.

MEASURED, twice, an hour apart:
  * 21:56 UTC — last 40 runs: 35 completed, 3 in_progress, 2 queued. A Gerrit Verified Gate run
    had completed successfully at 21:40.
  * 22:07 UTC — last 40 runs: 35 completed, 4 in_progress, 1 queued.
  * The two runs cited as evidence of starvation: 32306779189 created 22:01:04 (queued ~6 min at
    the time of the claim) and 32306986850 created 22:03:35, status IN_PROGRESS and updating.

The pool is healthy and these runs are minutes old, not hours. Ordinary queueing was mistaken for
infrastructure failure.

WHAT WAS CORRECT in the same report, and is worth keeping: the `Verified -1` recorded against PS1
is genuinely NOT a test verdict. The CI bot's own message reads
`verify-identity (whole-store authorship gate): CANCELLED (not a test verdict)` — the PS1 run was
cancelled because uploading PS2 superseded it. So there is no known test failure on this change,
and no recheck was warranted; declining to issue one was the right call for the wrong reason.

CURRENT STATE: PS2 (78c9cce398) is the current patchset, 0 unresolved comments, labels pending with
its Verified run actively executing. Expected to resolve without intervention. Do NOT recheck, and
do NOT treat this change as infrastructure-blocked.
